subject: Renderer: GPU-driven vegetation (3 phases)
description:
- Phase 1: GPU-driven props via compute cull plus ExecuteIndirect, visually identical.
- Phase 2: LODs and impostors, plus GPU ground cover and flowers.
- Phase 3: palm, shrub and hedge content with wind.
The renderer owns the vegetation builders in propmesh.cpp. Each phase signs off on its own.
